title: Doge (meme)
description: Internet meme featuring a Shiba Inu dog
extract: Doge is an Internet meme that became popular in 2013. The meme is based on a 2010 photograph of Kabosu, a Japanese Shiba Inu, and typically pairs the image with multicoloured Comic Sans text rendered in broken English. Doge was named Know Your Meme's top meme of 2013, and has been repeatedly revived: first as the basis for Dogecoin in December 2013, again during the 2021 retail speculation wave, and a third time in 2023 when the photograph was adopted as the logo of the social network X.
extract_html: Doge is an Internet meme that became popular in 2013.
